item.title: "Collaboration" Is Bullshit
item.description:
📝 They moved when they were ordered and they held their positions, and they mimicked the outward appearance of a soldier in battle - but shoot, they did not. Marshall's riflemen were ordinary people responding to the diffusion of responsibility that happens inside any group. item.title: The IBM scientist who rewrote the rules of information just won a Turing Award
item.description:
📝 ” The field Bennett helped build rests on the idea that information follows physical rules —and that can include quantum physics. Rolf Landauer, an IBM physicist who would recruit Bennett to the company, challenged that in a provocative 1961 paper, arguing that information is fundamentally physical and obeys the laws of thermodynamics. Building on that work, Bennett showed in a 1973 paper that computation could in principle be carried out reversibly, run forward and then backward without any net energy cost, revealing a deep connection between physics and information that most scientists had not seen.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ibm.com/think/news/ibm-scientist-charles-bennett-turing-award
